guards: A threshold-style reference range - a cut-off, not an interval - must parse and be kept as printed text. Typing reference_range numerically, or splitting it on a hyphen that is not there, rejects this payload and flips schema_valid; that rejection is what the case detects. The range is not an asserted value: the canonical payload escapes the comparison character, so asserting it would pin the escaping, not the range.
